CustomField.description: Text the failure must contain, ignoring case: the response body (HTTP_RESPONSE), the exception message (CALLOUT_EXCEPTION), or the record's errors written as STATUS_CODE: message (DML_ERRORS). Blank matches any text.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Store the distinctive part, such as Material does not exist, not a whole response: bodies carry timestamps and IDs. For DML, a status code such as DUPLICATE_VALUE also matches.
CustomField.label: Error Message
